question: Could you help me calculate the average of the total number of payments made using the most preferred payment method for each product category, where the most preferred payment method in a category is the one with the highest number of payments?
sql:
WITH payment_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        p.product_category_name,
        op.payment_type,
        COUNT(*) as payment_count
    FROM olist_orders o
    JOIN olist_order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN olist_order_payments op ON o.order_id = op.order_id
    JOIN olist_products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    GROUP BY p.product_category_name, op.payment_type
),
ranked_payments AS (
    SELECT 
        product_category_name,
        payment_type,
        payment_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_category_name ORDER BY payment_count DESC) as rn
    FROM payment_counts
),
most_preferred AS (
    SELECT 
        product_category_name,
        payment_type as most_preferred_payment
    FROM ranked_payments
    WHERE rn = 1
),
category_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        p.product_category_name,
        COUNT(*) as total_payments
    FROM olist_orders o
    JOIN olist_order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN olist_order_payments op ON o.order_id = op.order_id
    JOIN olist_products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM most_preferred mp 
        WHERE mp.product_category_name = p.product_category_name 
        AND op.payment_type = mp.most_preferred_payment
    )
    GROUP BY p.product_category_name
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) as num_categories,
    SUM(total_payments) as total_all_payments,
    AVG(total_payments) as avg_payments
FROM category_totals
